prompt:
Edit this UI mockup to remove all AI-written promotional copy and all invented interface elements. This is a working Chinese desktop utility, not a landing page. Keep its broad layout, warm ivory / near-white surfaces, restrained muted gold, readable dark text, and comfortable spacing. Reduce the oversized page heading to a modest 24px, use clean Chinese system sans serif for all UI, keep OpenRisingStones wordmark modest. Crucial: visible text must ONLY come from the following whitelist or exact equipment rows below. Absolutely no slogan, motivational sentence, marketing subtitle, English translation, fictitious profile/avatar, timestamp, fake footer, version number, breadcrumb, notification, global search, toolbox, or explanatory caption. Do not replace removed text with new text. Collapse the empty space left by removed subtitles.

Whitelist: OpenRisingStones; 首页; 招募; 幻化; 超域传送; 配装; 设置; 登录; 主题; 学者 · 日常配装; 学者; 已保存; 撤销; 重做; 另存; 导入 / 分享; 新建; 方案设置; 等级 100; 同步 无; 中原之民; 当前配装; 选择装备; 属性 / 比较; 最优配装; 武器; 头部; 身体; 手部; 腿部; 脚部; 耳饰; 项链; 手镯; 戒指 1; 戒指 2; 食物; 药品; 未选择; 编辑镶嵌 / 属性; 搜索装备名称; 筛选; 品级; 780; 795; 全部获取途径; 装备; 暴击; 信念; 直击; 魔晶石; 预览; 替换装备; GCD; 2.40s; 平均品级; 790; 数据 7.55; —.
Use only these exact equipment names with stated level: 总冠军魔导典 i795, 幻境魔导典·秘影 i795, 改良型王国黄铜魔导典 i790, 虚王魔导典 i785, 总冠军治愈头甲 i790, 改良型王国黄铜治愈胸衣 i790, 总冠军治愈手铠 i790, 总冠军治愈长裤 i790, 总冠军治愈胫甲 i790. Other equipment slots display 未选择.
Candidate table exactly four equipment rows: 总冠军魔导典 i795 with 暴击313 信念447 直击—; 幻境魔导典·秘影 i795 with — — —; 改良型王国黄铜魔导典 i790 with — — —; 虚王魔导典 i785 with — — —. Use small neutral outlined dots for materia, aligned to a stable slot track. No colorful bubble dots, no invented gear art, no large equipment illustrations. If gear icon not known, omit it; never invent one. Do not write AI placeholders or specimen labels. 已保存 is quiet noninteractive status text, never a gold primary button. Do not invent a save button. On plan setting row show only collapsed 方案设置 plus quiet 等级 100 · 同步 无 · 中原之民 summary, no expanded inputs. Keep all current module destinations including 首页. The result must look like a plausible real working application screenshot, not a design presentation with labels.
Preserve C: 176px full-text global left sidebar, modest wordmark at top, 首页 招募 幻化 超域传送 配装 destinations; 主题 设置 登录 at bottom. Main concise header 学者 · 日常配装, quiet 已保存 and undo redo 另存 导入 / 分享 新建. Task tabs 当前配装 / 选择装备 / 属性 / 比较 / 最优配装, active 当前配装. Main uncluttered two-column equipment overview, eleven slots, six supplied equipped item names and remaining 未选择. No fake 左侧装备/右侧装备 headers, no guessed stats, no footer or slogan. Each slot row has a clear slot label, actual name, ilvl and tiny outlined materia dots, plus subtle edit action, no illustrations.
copyPolicy: Functional UI copy only. No slogans, promotional subtitles, invented profile, timestamps or extra modules.
